headlines.title: Shanghai beats GDP estimates with 5.6% growth – but two-speed recovery persists
headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...

headlines.summary: 【今年上半年山东社会融资规模同比增长8.3%】截至6月末，山东社会融资规模达27.3万亿元，同比增长8.3%、增速连续86个月高于全国。上半年，金融业增加值同比增长7.8%，继续呈现“四个好于”积极态势，好于全国1.1个百分点，好于GDP增速2.2个百分点，好于服务业增速1.4个百分点，好于去年同期2.7个百分点。

headlines.title_en: Shandong Province's Aggregate Social Financing Grows 8.3% YoY in First Half of Year
headlines.summary_en: [Shandong's social financing scale up 8.3% year-on-year in first half of 2024] As of end-June, Shandong's social financing scale reached 27.3 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year, with growth outpacing national average for 86 consecutive months. In the first half, value-added of the financial sector grew 7.8% year-on-year, maintaining a positive trend 'better than four benchmarks': 1.1 percentage points above national average, 2.2 percentage points above GDP growth, 1.4 percentage points above services sector growth, and 2.7 percentage points above the same period last year.

headlines.summary_en: Since July, nearly 540 listed companies have hosted institutional surveys; over 110 expect net profit growth in first half of 2024; some high-growth targets attract concentrated institutional attention. headlines.title: A股科技板块持续调整，机构关注资源品与红利低位股
headlines.summary: 近期，A股科技板块明显调整，市场风险偏好有所回落。Wind数据显示，截至7月23日的近3个交易日，有色金属、电气设备、石油石化等板块率先获得资金回流，消费、红利和金融板块则呈现结构性机会。机构认为，本轮调整更多是外部扰动、交易拥挤和估值压力集中释放的结果，市场中长期运行逻辑并未发生根本变化。在半年报密集披露的窗口期，资金正由前期高弹性、高估值的方向，逐步转向业绩确定性更强、估值更具安全边际的板块。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: A-Share Tech Sector Continues Correction; Institutions Focus on Resources and Low-Priced Dividend Stocks
headlines.summary_en: Recently, A-share tech sector has notably corrected, market risk appetite has declined. Wind data shows over the past three trading days to July 23, sectors like non-ferrous metals, electrical equipment, and oil & petrochemicals saw initial capital inflows, while consumer, dividend, and financial sectors showed structural opportunities. Institutions believe this correction is more a result of external disturbances, crowded trades, and concentrated valuation pressure release, with the medium-to-long-term market logic unchanged. During the semi-annual report disclosure window, capital is shifting from high-elasticity, high-valuation directions to sectors with stronger earnings certainty and greater valuation safety margins. (China Securities Journal)
